arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions_within_2_minutes FROM (SELECT id, card_id, date, lag(date) OVER (PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY date, id) AS previous FROM transactions) WHERE previous IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%s', date) - strftime('%s', previous) <= 120
arguments.explanation: Counts the transactions that came 2 minutes or less after the previous transaction on the same card.
assumptions: 'Within 2 minutes' means 120 seconds or less after the card's previous transaction, 120 seconds included.
Every transaction counts, whatever its amount (negative amounts too), error status or fraud label.
When two transactions on a card have the same timestamp, the one with the lower id comes first. The later one counts as 0 seconds after it.
